---
title: "Meetup_data"
author: "Radhika Patel"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r import}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
url <- "https://www.meetup.com/find/?keywords=art&location=us--nj--New+Brunswick&source=EVENTS"
page <- read_html(url)
```

```{r date w/time}
dates <- 
  page %>%
    html_nodes("time") %>%
    html_text(trim = TRUE)

head(dates)
```

```{r group/location}
groups <- 
  page %>%
    html_nodes(".text--labelSecondary a") %>%
    html_text(trim = TRUE)

locations <- 
  page %>%
    html_nodes(".venueDisplay-venue-address") %>%
    html_text(trim = TRUE)

head(groups)
head(locations)
```

```{r}
titles <- page %>%
  html_nodes("h3") %>%
  html_text(trim = TRUE)

meetups <- data.frame(
  title = titles,
  date = dates,
  group = groups,
  location = locations,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

head(meetups)

meetups_clean <- meetups %>%
  filter(title != "") %>%
  distinct(title, .keep_all = TRUE)
```
